Hi everyone! I have a question 😊

I’m currently in Israel on an A/2 (student) visa, as I came here to study my Master’s degree. My visa expires on the 25th, and I would like to stay in Israel.

I have a partner here (he has Israeli citizenship), but we are not married and we don’t live together. Neither of us is Jewish. I have been living here for almost 2 years. 

Is there any way to apply for a visa or change my status based on our relationship in this situation? Has anyone been through something similar?

Thank you🙏🏻
